macbook_pro_touch_display_release.summary: Apple introduced 14‑inch and 16‑inch MacBook Pro laptops featuring touch‑enabled OLED screens while keeping keyboard and trackpad as primary inputs still.
highlights: Touch input works alongside keyboard and trackpad, with gestures like swipe‑up Dock and swipe‑down Spotlight/Siri AI.
New UI cues include expanding “traffic light” window controls and spaced‑out list items when touched.
Multi‑touch supports up to 10 fingers; long‑press acts as right‑click, and quick window moves trigger Split View.
Settings let users disable touch input and the illuminated Apple logo; the camera is stabilized for video calls.

binance_6_3b_heist.headline: Hackers Swipe $6.3 B from Binance in Record Crypto Heist
binance_6_3b_heist.summary: North Korean‑backed group TraderTraitor exploited Ethereum’s EIP‑7702 to steal roughly $6.3 billion from Binance, prompting a massive security response.
highlights: Hackers stole about $6.3 billion, four times larger than any previous crypto theft.
Approximately 40% of the loss was in stablecoins from Circle, Ripple Labs and Tether.
The breach used a malicious smart contract via EIP‑7702 to control Binance’s Ethereum wallet.
Binance set aside $6.34 billion for user reimbursements and halted withdrawals pending remediation.
TRM Labs traced the attack to the North Korean state‑backed group TraderTraitor after a 36‑hour rehearsal.

apple_intelligence_china_rollout.headline: Apple Intelligence Arrives in China via iOS 27.3 Beta
apple_intelligence_china_rollout.summary: Apple has enabled select Apple Intelligence features in China through the iOS 27.3 beta, leveraging Alibaba’s Qwen model after regulatory approval.
highlights: Live Translation works across Messages, FaceTime, Phone and supported AirPods
Writing Tools now rewrite, proofread, summarize and generate text with Qwen
Visual Intelligence identifies objects and places; Clean Up removes unwanted photo elements
Siri gains type‑to‑Siri and deeper Qwen‑powered answers, though core Siri AI remains unavailable

ai_scraping_optout_standard.headline: AI Giants Agree on New Policy Token to Block Scraping
ai_scraping_optout_standard.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic will honor a shared policy token in robots.txt that lets publishers opt out of AI training data scraping.
highlights: The shared “policy token” will be placed in a site’s robots.txt file
OpenAI, Google and Microsoft pledge to restrict crawlers that encounter the token
Anthropic has already adopted the signal; Google and Microsoft will support it next year
Meta’s Andy Stone expressed support but has not confirmed compliance

apple_intelligence_china_rollout_duplica.headline: Apple Intelligence arrives in China with iOS 27.3 rollout
apple_intelligence_china_rollout_duplica.summary: Apple will debut its Apple Intelligence suite in China via an iOS 27.3 beta on November 4, followed by a full release in December.
highlights: iOS 27.3 beta launches November 4, full release slated for December
Features include notification summaries, real‑time translation, rewriting tools, visual intelligence, and object removal
Apple partnered with **Alibaba** to integrate its **Qwen** chatbot, echoing earlier OpenAI ChatGPT integration
Apple Intelligence received Chinese regulatory approval in July and a China‑specific LLM was trained in August

supply_chain_attack_claude_extensions.headline: Malicious Anthropic Claude Extension Sneaks into Cursor Marketplace, Affects Up to 5,000 Users
supply_chain_attack_claude_extensions.summary: A rogue Anthropic Claude Code extension was briefly available in the Cursor IDE marketplace, potentially exposing up to 5,000 developers to a backdoor.
highlights: The malicious extension was live for roughly 11 hours on Thursday
At most 5,000 users downloaded the tainted Claude Code extension
A design flaw prevented full infection on most targets
Cursor temporarily shut down its extension marketplace during investigation

ios_27_3_china_features.headline: iOS 27.3 Brings Select Apple Intelligence Features to China
ios_27_3_china_features.summary: Apple will release iOS 27.3 in December, adding Writing Tools, Genmoji, Notification Summaries and Live Translation with AirPods in China, but Siri AI and Image Playground remain unavailable.
highlights: iOS 27.3 adds Writing Tools, Genmoji, Notification Summaries and Live Translation with AirPods in China
Siri AI and Image Playground are excluded
Features limited to iPhone 15 Pro and newer until further approvals
First beta arrives next week, full release slated for December

malware_ai.headline: AI‑Powered Infostealer ‘Volta‑Autodoxer’ Targets Victims with LLM Analysis
malware_ai.summary: Researchers at Cisco Talos discovered a new infostealer that uses commercial LLMs to profile victims and prioritize high‑value data for theft.
highlights: Volta‑Autodoxer gathers passwords, tokens, crypto seed phrases, and active sessions from browsers and apps
It sends collected data to Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.6 via OpenRouter, with fallbacks to Moonshot Kimi K2 and Google
The malware includes a 240‑word prompt that directs the AI to produce an executive summary of the victim’s worth and opsec

shared_robots_txt_control.headline: Google, Microsoft, OpenAI Adopt Shared robots.txt AI Training Control
shared_robots_txt_control.summary: Google announced a unified robots.txt signal for AI training preferences, joined by Microsoft and OpenAI, aiming for industry‑wide adoption by 2027.
highlights: Google will interpret a shared __usage_ai-training token as a disallow for Google-Extended unless explicitly allowed
OpenAI pledged to honor the common robots.txt signal while keeping its existing crawler controls
Microsoft will replace NoArchive and NoCache with the new training and grounding preferences starting February 1, 2027
The IETF draft defining the signal, authored by Anthropic’s Kevin Kelley, is slated to expire May 3, 2027

ai_crawling_opt_out_standard.headline: Tech Giants Back New AI Crawling Opt‑Out Standard
ai_crawling_opt_out_standard.summary: Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI announced a unified robots.txt extension to let sites block AI training scrapers with a single entry.
highlights: Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI filed a draft with the IETF to modify the Robots Exclusion Protocol
The new setting lets publishers block all generative‑AI data‑collection crawlers via one robots.txt rule
Microsoft’s AI Grounding feature will stop its services from querying pages for answer generation
OpenAI and ChatGPT will adopt the standard in the coming months, with Google following next year

shared_robots_txt_signal.headline: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic Adopt New robots.txt Signal for AI Training
shared_robots_txt_signal.summary: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft will honor a new robots.txt directive that lets publishers block AI‑training crawlers while permitting selective access.
highlights: The directive introduces a **User-Agent: __usage_ai-training** tag that publishers can set to disallow AI‑training crawlers.
**Google**, **OpenAI**, **Anthropic** and **Microsoft** have pledged to recognize and respect the new signal.
Implementation timelines: **Anthropic** already supports it; **OpenAI** will roll out in months; **Google** early 2027
The signal does not retroactively erase data already scraped for models like **Gemini**.

fundraising_round_2026_10_31.headline: OpenAI Secures $11 Billion, Falls Short of $30 Billion Goal
fundraising_round_2026_10_31.summary: OpenAI raised only $11 billion of its $30 billion target, valuing the firm at $1.25 trillion amid waning investor appetite in 2026.
highlights: Raised $11 billion, far below the $30 billion fundraising aim
Valuation settled at $1.25 trillion, short of the $1.4 trillion goal
Investor pullback linked to weak results from Google, Amazon and Intel
Plans to seek up to $20 billion from family offices and high‑net‑worth individuals
Considering an IPO early next year while rival Anthropic eyes a November listing

daybreakbluedatause.headline: OpenAI to Train Models on Daybreak Blue Data Starting Nov 29
daybreakbluedatause.summary: OpenAI will begin using Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data for model training on Nov 29, despite earlier opt‑out restrictions and researcher backlash.
highlights: OpenAI announced the policy shift via email to Trusted Access program members
Daybreak Blue data was previously excluded even when users enabled "improve the model for everyone"
A separate opt‑out option will be offered after initial backlash
Flagged interactions may still be used for safety reviews
Researchers recall the Buckmaster‑Alpöge incident as a cautionary precedent

voltainfostealerllmstage.headline: Cisco Talos Unveils VOLTA Infostealer’s AI‑Powered Victim Ranking Stage
voltainfostealerllmstage.summary: Cisco Talos researcher reveals that the VOLTA‑AUTODOXER infostealer now uses a large‑language‑model stage to rank victims’ monetizable assets with detailed forensic analysis.
highlights: VOLTA extracts credentials, cookies, payment cards, and cloud tokens before invoking an LLM for asset valuation
The LLM call uses anthropic/claude‑opus‑4.6 with fallbacks to moonshotai/kimi‑k2 and google/gemini‑2.5‑flash
The AI‑generated dossier is packaged locally and exfiltrated in staged archives
Talos released the open‑source CAIRN toolkit to hunt AI‑integrated malware without executing binaries

super_app_expansion.headline: TikTok pushes toward super‑app status with restaurant guide and payments
super_app_expansion.summary: TikTok unveiled a community‑driven ‘Must Eat’ guide and is testing direct‑message money transfers, signaling its bid to become a one‑stop super app.
highlights: ‘Must Eat’ aggregates over 40 million posts to curate restaurant recommendations by city, cuisine, price and rating
TikTok Pay, already used for TikTok Shop purchases in Southeast Asia, may soon enable peer‑to‑peer transfers in DMs
The company applied to Brazil’s central bank to operate as a fintech offering lending and payment services
TikTok Shop’s U.S. sales grew 108% in 2025 to $15.82 billion, now accounting for 18.2% of social commerce

apple_ceo_ai_statement.headline: Apple CEO John Ternus Says Company Won’t Ship AI for Its Own Sake
apple_ceo_ai_statement.summary: In a Wired interview, Apple CEO John Ternus emphasized that Apple will use AI selectively, focusing on products users love rather than chasing AI trends.
highlights: Apple launched an upgraded Siri with more advanced AI features this summer.
CEO John Ternus, appointed in September, stressed selective AI integration over hype.
Ternus told Wired’s Steven Levy that AI should be invisible to users, enhancing experience.
He warned that AI‑driven agents could eventually reduce the need for traditional apps.

claude_duet_rollout.headline: Anthropic Rolls Out Claude Duet Personal Agent for Pro Subscribers
claude_duet_rollout.summary: Claude Duet, Anthropic’s always‑on AI agent, launches in preview for US Claude Pro and Max users, requiring a waitlist signup and costing $20 per month.
highlights: Claude Duet runs on its own VM with a dedicated browser and can access connected apps.
Available only to Claude Pro and Max subscribers in the United States during preview.
Users must join a waitlist and provide device type, name, company and task description.
Anthropic bundles Duet with the $20‑per‑month Pro plan, cheaper than OpenAI’s $100‑plus Dot agents.

binance_hack_north_korea_attribution.headline: FBI Blames North Korea’s TraderTraitor for Record $6.3B Binance Hack
binance_hack_north_korea_attribution.summary: The FBI has identified North Korea’s elite hacking unit TraderTraitor as the perpetrators of the $6.3 billion Binance breach, the largest crypto theft to date.
highlights: FBI links TraderTraitor to both the $6.3 B Binance hack and the $1.5 B Bybit hack of 2025.
Binance has replenished roughly 90 % of the stolen assets, covering $6 B of losses.
Withdrawals are resuming in phased batches, starting with major networks like Bitcoin.

openai_is_steering_chatgpt_users_toward_.headline: OpenAI Limits Paid ChatGPT Accounts per Card and Device
openai_is_steering_chatgpt_users_toward_.summary: OpenAI now caps the number of paid ChatGPT accounts that can share a single payment card or device, restricting multi‑subscription use.
highlights: Card and device limits apply to ChatGPT Go, Plus, Pro 100, Pro 200, and Pro 500
Free, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans are exempt from the restrictions
Logging out does not free a spot; users must purchase extra credits or resets
The move follows OpenAI’s shift toward revenue‑focused product bundling

chatgpt_pricing_merger.headline: OpenAI Merges ChatGPT Chat and Work, Ending Unlimited Prompt Pricing
chatgpt_pricing_merger.summary: Starting December, OpenAI will combine Chat and Work in ChatGPT, sharing a single token budget across Plus, Pro and Business plans.
highlights: All three subscription tiers will use one combined token budget for ChatGPT and Codex
Instant‑model chats are exempt from the token count, preserving a flat‑rate experience
OpenAI doubled usage limits on higher‑priced plans ahead of the merger

chatgpt_share_vulnerability.headline: OpenAI Pays $5 K for Bug That Could Execute Code via Malicious ChatGPT Share Links
chatgpt_share_vulnerability.summary: Security researchers earned $5 K after reporting a flaw that lets attackers run code in logged‑in sessions of anyone who opens a crafted ChatGPT share link.
highlights: OpenAI offered a $5 K bounty for the vulnerability
The bug could execute arbitrary code in any logged‑in ChatGPT session
Exploitation requires only opening a malicious share link
Researchers disclosed the issue through the OpenAI bug bounty program

deepgram_acquires_daily_voice_ai.headline: Deepgram Acquires Daily, Adding $62M‑Funded Pipecat Voice AI Framework
deepgram_acquires_daily_voice_ai.summary: Deepgram has purchased Daily, the open‑source voice AI developer behind Pipecat, for an undisclosed amount, expanding its enterprise AI portfolio.
highlights: Deepgram announced the acquisition of Daily, a voice AI startup that raised over $62M in funding
Daily created the open‑source voice AI framework Pipecat, now under Deepgram’s control
The deal’s financial terms were not disclosed, but it strengthens Deepgram’s enterprise offerings
Deepgram aims to integrate Pipecat’s technology into its existing suite of voice AI tools

deepseek_super_agent_open_source.headline: DeepSeek Open‑Sources Super‑Agent, a Proactive Coding Assistant for Developer Chats
deepseek_super_agent_open_source.summary: DeepSeek released an open‑source prototype called Super‑Agent that continuously watches developer group chats, flags coding problems, and automatically proposes fixes.
highlights: Super‑Agent monitors GitHub repository issues and pull requests in real time.
It suggests code snippets and fixes without requiring explicit prompts.
Designed to reduce human attention while handling multiple coding tasks concurrently.
Aims to compete with Anthropic’s Claude Code in the autonomous coding arena.

massive_crypto_heist.headline: FBI Blames North Korea for $6.3 B Binance Crypto Heist
massive_crypto_heist.summary: The FBI attributes the October 29 hack that stole over $6.3 billion from Binance to North Korean actors dubbed “TraderTraitor.”
highlights: FBI identified “TraderTraitor” group as North Korean hackers
$6.3 billion in crypto was taken from Binance customers
Stolen assets were quickly converted into Ethereum for laundering via DeFi services
US Secret Service and IRS-CI assisted the investigation
Binance resumed withdrawals after temporarily freezing accounts

openai_buy_google_tpu.headline: OpenAI to Purchase Google TPUs, Reducing Reliance on Nvidia GPUs
openai_buy_google_tpu.summary: OpenAI announced plans to buy Google’s tensor processing units, diversifying its AI compute supply chain as demand for advanced models surges.
highlights: OpenAI will acquire Google **TPUs** in a deal whose financial terms remain undisclosed
The move signals a shift away from exclusive dependence on **Nvidia GPUs** for training and inference
OpenAI is simultaneously developing its own custom chip with **Broadcom**, slated for deployment before 2027
Google’s **Alphabet** expects modest TPU revenue recognition in 2026, with larger impact in 2027

major_breach_recovery.headline: Binance Restarts Withdrawals After $6.3 Billion Hack
major_breach_recovery.summary: Binance will resume crypto withdrawals in phases after covering 95% of the $6.3 billion loss from the massive security breach.
highlights: Withdrawals resume gradually, with Bitcoin still partially suspended and Ethereum deposits normal
Binance has reimbursed most stolen assets and will continue buying remaining illiquid tokens
FBI attributes the attack to North Korean group TraderTraitor, which prioritized converting funds to Ethereum

antigravity_voice_agent.headline: Google readies Antigravity 2.0 with new voice‑enabled Chief of Staff
antigravity_voice_agent.summary: Google plans to launch Antigravity 2.0 next week, adding a live voice mode for the upcoming Chief of Staff agent that supports conversational interaction.
highlights: The upcoming **Chief of Staff** agent will feature selectable voices and animated audio visualizations
Users can adjust speech speed, mute audio or microphone, and view text alongside spoken responses
An overview dashboard will let users manage extensions, pending tasks, and background processes
The release aims to expand Antigravity beyond agent management toward a central workspace

security_reviews_ai_agents.headline: Security Reviews Lag Behind Enterprise AI Agents, Tokenization Offers Speed
security_reviews_ai_agents.summary: Enterprises deploying AI agents face slow security reviews, prompting a shift to tokenization‑based protection to keep data usable and accelerate deployments.
highlights: Project‑by‑project reviews cause delays for 83% of AI initiatives
Protegrity’s tokenization replaces sensitive values without mathematical algorithms
Tokenization is quantum‑ready, avoiding future cryptography risks

binance_hack_response.headline: Binance Launches Global War Room After $6.3 B Hack Attributed to North Korean TraderTraitor
binance_hack_response.summary: Binance mobilized a 100‑person war room, coordinated with the FBI and other crypto firms, and began phased withdrawals after covering 90% of the stolen assets.
highlights: ~100 staff in a global war room to manage the response
FBI attributes the $6.3 B theft to North Korea’s elite unit TraderTraitor
Binance replenished 90% of the stolen assets and resumed withdrawals in phases
Net outflows reached $3.64 B within hours of reopening
Collaboration with USSS, IRS‑CI and other agencies to trace and freeze illicit funds

aramco_humain_acquisition.headline: Aramco Takes 49% Stake in AI Firm HUMAIN for $2.6B
aramco_humain_acquisition.summary: Aramco, via a subsidiary, bought a 49% stake in Saudi AI company HUMAIN, contributing SAR 9.9 billion cash and key AI assets.
highlights: Aramco paid $2.6 billion in cash for the minority stake
PIF retains 51% ownership while both shareholders supply AI talent and infrastructure
HUMAIN aims to deploy 3 GW of AI data‑center capacity by 2030
The deal includes transfer of the Saudi Company for Artificial Intelligence to HUMAIN

aramco_humain_acquisition_techmeme.headline: Saudi Aramco Takes 49% Stake in AI Startup Humain for $2.6B
aramco_humain_acquisition_techmeme.summary: Aramco will invest roughly $2.6 billion in cash and provide AI, compute and digital assets for a 49% share in Humain, while the PIF keeps 51%.
highlights: Aramco contributes ~$2.6 billion in cash in 2026
The deal includes AI models, high‑performance compute and digital asset support
Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund retains a 51% controlling stake
Humain gains strategic access to Aramco’s energy‑tech ecosystem

gdpx_launch.headline: SemiAnalysis Unveils GDPx Benchmark, Opus 5.5 Leads with 12% Score
gdpx_launch.summary: SemiAnalysis released the agentic capability benchmark GDPx, measuring 11 domains such as chip design and cybersecurity, with Opus 5.5 achieving a 12% score.
highlights: GDPx evaluates agentic abilities across 11 distinct domains.
Opus 5.5 attained the highest score of 12% among tested models.
Domains include chip design, cybersecurity, and RSI.
Benchmark aims to standardize measurement of AI agents for industry and research.

windows_malware_ai.headline: AI‑Powered VOLTA‑AUTODOXER Malware Profiles Victims for Ransomware
windows_malware_ai.summary: New malware steals credentials and crypto wallets, then uses AI models like Claude, Kimi K2, and Gemini 2.5 Flash to rank victim value.
highlights: VOLTA‑AUTODOXER exfiltrates passwords, tokens, seed phrases, and screenshots before AI assessment.
AI dossier generated via OpenRouter, defaulting to Claude, with fallbacks to Kimi K2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash.
Malware self‑deletes after posting ranked target assessments to a Telegram channel, leaving a debug file.

supermarket_freezers_cyberattack_europe.headline: European Supermarket Freezers Hit by “Cold War” Cyberattack
supermarket_freezers_cyberattack_europe.summary: Hackers remotely turned freezers in Ireland, Sweden, Belgium, Luxembourg and Estonia into heaters, spoiling food and echoing the October French incident.
highlights: Over 400 French supermarkets suffered losses in October 2026 when freezers heated to 120°F (50°C).
Targets now include **Supervalu**, **Axfood**, and **ICA** stores across five European nations.
The attacks exploit weak authentication in older IoT refrigeration management systems.
The US military is investigating similar refrigeration breaches at six domestic bases.

llmjacking_report.headline: Google reports LLMjacking attacks racking up $100K‑plus daily cloud bills
llmjacking_report.summary: Attackers hijacking enterprise LLM access are generating fraudulent cloud charges exceeding $100,000 per day, with some victims facing near‑million‑dollar bills before detection.
highlights: UNC6993 exploited mis‑configured service‑account keys to access LLM APIs
CVE‑2026‑40217 in LiteLLM allowed attackers to turn virtual keys into admin credentials
Jet Night token‑routing service sold stolen LLM access for $60‑monthly plans
Victims incurred up to $1 million in charges before access was revoked

anthropic_compute_deal_spree.headline: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in $115 B All‑Stock Deal, Targeting AI Data‑Center Market
anthropic_compute_deal_spree.summary: Marvell Technology announced a $115 billion all‑stock acquisition of optical components maker Lumentum, aiming to strengthen its AI connectivity portfolio.
highlights: Deal valued at $115 billion, including debt, creating one of the largest tech mergers of 2026
Lumentum’s optical components will bolster Marvell’s data‑center and AI chip offerings
Both companies received $2 billion investments from Nvidia earlier this year

applebees_security_issue.headline: Applebee’s Mobile App Flaw Exposed Customer Data via Hardcoded Credentials
applebees_security_issue.summary: A hardcoded database credential in Applebee’s Android app leaked names, emails, birthdays and other personal details, prompting a rapid fix by Dine Brands.
highlights: Researchers from What Security used AI to discover hardcoded credentials in the app’s source code.
Exposed data included names, emails, birth dates, phone numbers, ZIP codes and IP addresses.
The app has over one million Google Play downloads, increasing exposure risk.
Dine Brands patched the flaw and reported no evidence of unauthorized access.

malware_racket.headline: Google Bans MECOOL After Malware Botnet Hijacks 1.3 Million Android TV Boxes
malware_racket.summary: Google cut ties with Videostrong’s MECOOL Android TV boxes after uncovering a backdoor that turned 1.3 million devices into a malware‑driven botnet.
highlights: The XCPE backdoor enabled ad‑fraud, residential proxy enrollment, and data exfiltration.
Videostrong sold access to the compromised boxes to criminal affiliates.
Google revised its device review program to close the security testing gap.
Infected devices also included Android‑based IoT products such as karaoke machines and digital signage.

marvell_acquires_lumentum.headline: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in $115 B All‑Stock AI Connectivity Deal
marvell_acquires_lumentum.summary: Marvell will buy Lumentum for an implied $115 billion, exchanging each Lumentum share for 4.5 Marvell shares, creating a combined AI connectivity powerhouse.
highlights: Lumentum valued at $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium
Marvell shareholders will own ~67% and Lumentum shareholders ~33% of the combined company
Combined addressable market projected at $550 billion with over $1 billion in annual run‑rate synergies
Deal expected to close in H1 2028 pending stockholder and regulatory approvals
Matt Murphy remains CEO, and three Lumentum directors join Marvell’s board

crypto_exchange_breach_brazil.headline: Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals After $46M Breach, Tether Freezes $4.5M USDT
crypto_exchange_breach_brazil.summary: Brazil's leading crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin stopped all withdrawals following a security breach that exposed over $46 million in user assets, prompting Tether to freeze more than $4.5 million USDT.
highlights: The breach was identified by blockchain analytics firm Arkham, which reported the loss of $46 million plus in assets.
Tether responded by freezing 4.5 million USDT linked to the compromised wallets.
Mercado Bitcoin has suspended both crypto and fiat withdrawals while investigators assess the incident.

rsi_warning.headline: Anthropic Signals Imminent Leap Toward Recursive Self‑Improvement AI
rsi_warning.summary: Anthropic’s latest S‑1/A filing warns it may soon achieve recursive self‑improvement, a capability that could dramatically accelerate AI development while raising safety concerns.
highlights: Anthropic’s filing cites recent use of AI to create models whose capability jumps were not initially recognized
The company’s Responsible Scaling Policy now flags potential "dramatically accelerated progress" from AI‑assisted R&D
Anthropic asserts no model has yet crossed the RSI threshold and vows to keep humans in the loop
Claude’s coding, math, and cybersecurity abilities have surged, prompting heightened scrutiny

flashprove_release.headline: Anthropic Unveils FlashProve for Zero‑Knowledge AI Inference Proofs
flashprove_release.summary: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open‑source prototype that generates zkSNARK proofs confirming Llama 4 Maverick responses came from committed weights without revealing them.
highlights: Proof generation reaches 110 tokens per second for Meta’s Llama 4 Maverick
Zero‑knowledge proof verification runs on a CPU in about 17 seconds per request
Prover fits on a single 80 GB GPU with 290 GB host memory
Open‑source repository includes C++ and Lean verifiers under the Apache 2.0 license

ascend960dt_hbm_supply.headline: Huawei's Ascend 960DT AI Chip to Leverage Samsung and SK Hynix HBM
ascend960dt_hbm_supply.summary: Huawei told select clients that the upcoming flagship AI processor Ascend 960DT will primarily use high‑bandwidth memory supplied by Samsung and SK Hynix.
highlights: The Ascend 960DT is positioned as Huawei's next‑generation flagship AI accelerator.
Samsung and SK Hynix will provide the majority of the HBM modules for the chip.
Huawei disclosed the memory sourcing to a limited group of enterprise customers.
The move highlights Huawei's continued reliance on external memory suppliers amid trade restrictions.

chatgpt_search_volume.headline: ChatGPT Captures Roughly 20% of Google Search Volume, OpenAI Claims
chatgpt_search_volume.summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT now handles about one‑fifth of the queries that Google Search processes, marking a significant shift in AI‑driven search competition.
highlights: ChatGPT’s search usage is estimated at **20%** of **Google Search** volume
OpenAI’s Adam Fry highlighted rapid growth since the AI‑search push two years ago
Google acknowledges lower monetization as AI features expand in its search product
Ads in ChatGPT are reportedly well‑received by users

gpt_6_astra_hardware_design.headline: OpenAI Claims GPT-6 Astra Designed Hardware Device in Under a Week
gpt_6_astra_hardware_design.summary: OpenAI reports its GPT-6 Astra model created a complete hardware device, from enclosure to firmware, in less than a week, with prototypes built in a month.
highlights: GPT-6 Astra handled enclosure design, PCB layout, component selection, trace routing, firmware, and UI autonomously
BenchCAD 2.0 benchmark shows the internal model scoring 0.875 while GPT-6 Astra reaches 0.594
Prototype batch produced by a contract manufacturer within a month despite several revision rounds
Token usage by OpenAI’s hardware teams for Codex and ChatGPT grew 23× since February

salesforce_cresta_acquisition.headline: Salesforce to Acquire Cresta for Reported $2.7 B, Expanding AI Service Suite
salesforce_cresta_acquisition.summary: Salesforce announced a $2.7 billion purchase of Cresta, adding AI‑driven customer service automation tools like Deputy and Opera to its Service Cloud.
highlights: Cresta’s platform uses AI to answer inquiries and schedule appointments
The deal follows Salesforce’s $3.6 billion acquisition of Fin Inc. earlier this year
Salesforce also agreed to buy Braze Inc. for $5.66 billion in AI marketing
Both Cresta and Braze deals are slated to close in the 2028 fiscal year

falcon_guardian_ai_kill_switch.headline: CrowdStrike Unveils AI Kill Switch in Falcon Guardian, Teams Up with Claude Cowork
falcon_guardian_ai_kill_switch.summary: CrowdStrike introduced a kill‑switch feature in its Falcon Guardian platform to halt rogue internal AI agents and announced integration with Anthropic’s Claude Cowork for enhanced threat response.
highlights: Falcon Guardian now includes an AI kill‑switch that can instantly disable misbehaving internal agents
The kill‑switch is designed to prevent autonomous AI actions that could compromise security
CrowdStrike partnered with Anthropic to embed Claude Cowork into Falcon Guardian for advanced analysis

siri_ai_integration_ios27_3.headline: Apple Enables Siri AI to Operate Across All Third‑Party Apps
siri_ai_integration_ios27_3.summary: Apple’s iOS 27.3 update lets Siri AI access any third‑party app, using personal context and on‑screen awareness to fulfill natural‑language requests.
highlights: Siri AI can execute tasks in third‑party apps without users naming the app
New “app skills” let developers combine multiple actions into a single voice command
Integration rolls out with iOS 27.3 and is available in Apple’s own apps like Calendar, Mail, and Maps
Users can query Siri AI about capabilities within each app, such as finding past coffee visits or archiving old files

whatsapp_ai_chats_android.headline: WhatsApp Adds Dedicated Meta AI Chats to Android Beta Update
whatsapp_ai_chats_android.summary: WhatsApp’s Android beta now lets users create separate Meta AI‑powered chats, complete with custom names and profile pictures, improving organization.
highlights: Separate Meta AI conversations appear as full chats in the chat list
Users can assign custom names and profile pictures to each AI chat
A new AI filter lets users quickly locate all Meta AI chats
Feature is rolling out to select Android beta testers via Google Play Store

oracle_scraps_ai_chip_lease_tencent.headline: Oracle aborts $7 B AI‑chip lease to Tencent after Trump‑admin pressure
oracle_scraps_ai_chip_lease_tencent.summary: Oracle cancelled a five‑year, roughly $7 billion agreement to lease about 100,000 advanced AI chips to Tencent following pressure from the Trump administration.
highlights: The deal was valued at approximately $7 billion over five years
It would have supplied Tencent with roughly 100,000 advanced AI chips
Pressure from the Trump administration forced Oracle to walk away
The cancellation underscores rising geopolitical scrutiny of AI hardware exports

amd_q3_earnings_ai_data_center.headline: AMD’s Data Center Surge Fueled by Agentic AI Beats Expectations
amd_q3_earnings_ai_data_center.summary: AMD reported a 45% revenue jump to $13.38 billion, driven by near‑doubling data‑center sales as agentic AI workloads boost CPU demand.
highlights: Data‑center revenue rose to 64% of total, up from 47% a year earlier.
AMD forecasts server revenue to double in fiscal 2027 as AI agents expand.
Major customers including Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Oracle are deploying AMD Helios rack systems.
AMD announced a $5 billion investment in Anthropic and a $1 billion equity stake in Meta’s Helion racks.

google_education_ai_policy.headline: Google threatens to block Search for schools that ban AI tools
google_education_ai_policy.summary: Google warned that schools restricting AI tools would lose Search access, sparking criticism from educators, politicians and antitrust officials over potential coercion.
highlights: Google announced new classroom AI products including Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Gemini in Classroom
Access to Google Search will be disabled for K‑12 accounts unless schools explicitly enable AI tools
Mayor Zohran Mamdani, Sen. Bernie Sanders and FTC Chair Lina Khan condemned the policy as coercive

iphone_jailbreak_lockdown.headline: Calif Jailbreak Bypasses Apple Lockdown Mode and Survives iOS 27.2 Update
iphone_jailbreak_lockdown.summary: A hacker team demonstrated a jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro that works in Lockdown Mode and remains functional after upgrading to iOS 27.2.
highlights: Calif successfully jailbroke an iPhone 18 Pro while Lockdown Mode was active.
The jailbreak persisted after installing iOS 27.2.
The exploit was triggered via a malicious PDF delivered through AirDrop.
Apple claims Lockdown Mode provides “extreme protection” against mercenary spyware.
Calif says it will not release a public jailbreak tool.

flashprove_cryptographic_verification.headline: Anthropic unveils FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model origins
flashprove_cryptographic_verification.summary: Anthropic's open‑source FlashProve uses zkSNARK proofs to confirm that a response came from a specific model without revealing its weights.
highlights: FlashProve generates proofs at roughly 110 tokens per second on a single H100 GPU for Meta's Llama 4 Maverick
Each proof is about 19 MB and can be verified in 17 seconds on a standard CPU
The system adds roughly 70×‑95× overhead compared with normal inference
FlashProve currently supports contexts up to 1,024 tokens and deterministic token selection only

ai_kill_switch_falcon_guardian.headline: CrowdStrike Unveils AI Kill Switch to Halt Rogue Enterprise Agents
ai_kill_switch_falcon_guardian.summary: CrowdStrike's new AI Kill Switch in Falcon Guardian lets human admins instantly terminate rogue AI agents, preventing damage and blocking relaunch across enterprise networks.
highlights: AI Kill Switch gives administrators direct control to terminate suspicious agent activity
Falcon Guardian monitors approved and shadow AI, detecting prompt injection attacks
Feature operates via Falcon sensor, stopping agents at gateway and endpoint

amdocs_eis_acquisition_2026_11_04.headline: Amdocs Buys EIS for $340 Million to Deploy Agentic AI in Insurance
amdocs_eis_acquisition_2026_11_04.summary: Amdocs has purchased insurance software firm EIS for $340 million, aiming to integrate its agentic AI platform aOS with EIS’s OneSuite for insurers.
highlights: Amdocs acquires EIS, adding policy administration, billing and claims systems to its portfolio
The deal includes $340 million cash with possible earn‑out payments tied to performance
EIS’s OneSuite is a cloud‑native, modular, API‑first platform with its own CoreGentic agentic tech
Amdocs plans to extend its aOS orchestration layer, originally built for telecom BSS/OSS, into insurance workflows

password_manager_breach_msecure.headline: mSecure breach forces users to reset passwords, MFA and passkeys
password_manager_breach_msecure.summary: mSecure’s encrypted cloud database was stolen, prompting the company to urge all users to change passwords, MFA methods and passkeys immediately.
highlights: Unauthorized actor obtained an encrypted copy of the mSecure cloud database containing current and former user data
Company advised rotating master passwords, stored credentials, two‑factor authentication and passkeys despite no evidence of
Criticism grew over sparse disclosures and the burden of resetting potentially hundreds of credentials
Similar incidents recently affected LastPass and Dashlane, highlighting broader password‑manager risks

copado_valoai_acquisition_2026_11_04.headline: Copado Acquires Valo.ai to Add Salesforce Security Observability
copado_valoai_acquisition_2026_11_04.summary: Copado’s purchase of Valo.ai brings real‑time security and operational observability to Salesforce environments, extending its governed delivery platform beyond release governance.
highlights: Copado integrates Valo.ai’s risk‑scoring engine to prioritize connected apps, dormant integrations, and excessive permissions.
Valo.ai provides a consolidated view of license spend, flagging inactive users and suggesting cost‑saving license changes.
The acquisition enables a phased roadmap where production intelligence feeds back into development and release workflows.
Valo.ai will remain a standalone product while Copado rolls out deeper integrated capabilities over time.

alabama_ai_data_center_campus.headline: Lambda Announces $33.1 B Alabama AI Data Center Campus
alabama_ai_data_center_campus.summary: Lambda plans to build the Red Clay Technology Center Campus in Lowndes County, a $33.1 billion AI data center powered by Alabama Power, slated to start in early 2027.
highlights: 1,000‑megawatt base power with expansion potential to 1,500 MW on a 2,200‑acre site.
Tax abatement offers 20‑year 50% reduction, projecting $2.85 billion county revenue through 2049.
Lambda commits $10 million community benefits and full funding for power infrastructure under the White House Ratepayer
Project will create over 1,000 construction jobs and 225 permanent technical positions.

openai_acquire_pierre_computer.headline: OpenAI to Acquire Pierre Computer, Boosting AI Agent Coding Tools
openai_acquire_pierre_computer.summary: OpenAI announced it will buy developer‑tool startup Pierre Computer, aiming to integrate its high‑performance code‑hosting service and open‑source libraries into Codex.
highlights: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer, a low‑profile developer tooling startup, with terms undisclosed
Pierre’s cloud service cut code‑retrieval latency by about 70% for AI startup Lovable Inc.
Pierre’s open‑source libraries Trees and Diffs power the interface of OpenAI’s Codex programming tool
OpenAI will keep Trees and Diffs open‑source and plans to embed Pierre’s paid storage into Codex

dreamhost_breach.headline: Hackers Exfiltrate Emails and Credentials from DreamHost in Prolonged Attack
dreamhost_breach.summary: DreamHost confirmed that hackers stole customer emails, credentials and session tokens after exploiting a file‑manager flaw, affecting well under 10% of its 400,000 users.
highlights: Attack began in August and remained undetected for months
Hackers obtained session tokens enabling full account takeover
Breach disclosed after multi‑day outage and password resets

chatgpt_gif_feature.headline: OpenAI Adds Native Animated GIF Creation to ChatGPT with Images 2.6
chatgpt_gif_feature.summary: OpenAI’s latest ChatGPT update, Images 2.6, lets users generate and edit animated GIFs directly, offering frame controls and two new API models for speed or quality.
highlights: ChatGPT can now turn prompts or uploaded photos into shareable animated GIFs
Users can adjust playback speed, edit individual frames, and preview each frame within the chat interface
Two new API models—GPT-Image-2.6 Flare for faster generation and GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst for higher‑quality output—are available
The rollout reaches all ChatGPT, Codex web, desktop and mobile users, expanding the existing Images 2.6 workflow

icloudcontentcheck.headline: Apple to Scan Public iCloud Links for Harmful Content in iOS 27.3
icloudcontentcheck.summary: Apple will begin scanning iCloud Photos and Drive links shared publicly for malware, CSAM and other harmful content starting with iOS 27.3 rollout.
highlights: Apple will access files shared via "Anyone with the link" for content checks
Content shared publicly is no longer end‑to‑end encrypted, even with Advanced Data Protection enabled
Violations may trigger account blocking, deletion or law‑enforcement involvement
The feature rolls out across iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, macOS 27.3 and visionOS 27.3

metaacquiresconductor.headline: Meta Acquires Conductor to Boost Parallel AI Coding Agents
metaacquiresconductor.summary: Meta has bought Conductor, enabling developers to run multiple AI coding agents simultaneously, and will integrate the team into its Superintelligence Labs.
highlights: Conductor lets developers run several AI coding agents in parallel
CEO Charlie Holtz confirmed the team will join Meta Superintelligence Labs
The acquisition expands Meta’s portfolio of AI development tools

gpt_5_6_sol_revenue_inflection.headline: OpenAI Unveils Images 2.6 with GIF Creation as Revenue Inflection Gains Momentum
gpt_5_6_sol_revenue_inflection.summary: OpenAI introduced Images 2.6, delivering 50% faster image generation and animated GIF support, while President Greg Brockman cites agentic coding tools and GPT‑5.6 Sol driving a Q3 revenue inflection.
highlights: Images 2.6 generates images 50% faster than its predecessor
Adds animated GIF creation and frame‑level editing in ChatGPT
API adds two new models: Flare (six‑second generation) and Sunburst (higher‑quality consistency)
Brockman says agentic coding tools and GPT‑5.6 Sol sparked a revenue inflection in Q3
OpenAI’s cyber pipeline patched 948 Linux kernel LPE flaws at a total API cost of $1.2 M

chrome_snapdragon_android_hack.headline: Hackers Exploit Chrome and Snapdragon GPU Flaws to Breach Android Phones
chrome_snapdragon_android_hack.summary: Researchers discovered a campaign that leveraged a Chrome bug and a Qualcomm Adreno driver flaw to silently steal cookies, logins and Wi‑Fi passwords from Android devices.
highlights: Chrome versions 139‑145 were vulnerable to CVE‑2026‑3910 code execution
Qualcomm Adreno driver flaw CVE‑2025‑27038 allowed sandbox escape
Malware named AndroSnitch harvested browser cookies, saved logins and Wi‑Fi passwords
Attack skipped Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra devices

images_2_6_release.headline: OpenAI Unveils Images 2.6 with GIF Creation and Faster Generation
images_2_6_release.summary: OpenAI's Images 2.6 rollout speeds image generation by 50%, adds GIF support, and introduces Flare and Sunburst models for developers via the API.
highlights: Images 2.6 generates images 50% faster and handles 4 billion images per week globally
New GIF feature lets users animate characters, sketches, and product shots in short loops
Flare can produce professional layouts in as little as six seconds at low quality
Sunburst focuses on high‑detail output and consistent edits for medium‑high quality
API now includes image markup, SVG export, and a complexity parameter for planning

ios_android_flaws_exploit.headline: Kremlin-linked Hackers Exploit Patched iOS and Android Flaws to Target Visitors
ios_android_flaws_exploit.summary: Hackers tied to Russia’s Foreign Intelligence Service used previously patched iOS and Android vulnerabilities to inject malicious JavaScript, stealing cookies, Wi‑Fi passwords, and device data.
highlights: The intrusion set leveraged a spoofed america250.holiday domain to proxy the legitimate america250.org site
Malicious JavaScript profiled devices and delivered platform‑specific payloads
Payloads attempted to exfiltrate browser cookies, Wi‑Fi passwords, and full mobile device data
Researchers linked the campaign to the Kremlin with moderate to high confidence

openai_linux_vuln_pipeline.headline: OpenAI’s Cyber Model Patches 948 Linux Kernel Flaws for $1.2 Million
openai_linux_vuln_pipeline.summary: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that identified, exploited and patched 948 local privilege escalation bugs in the Linux kernel at a total cost of $1.2 million.
highlights: The pipeline used an upcoming cyber model to automatically discover and validate each vulnerability.
All 948 flaws were patched, averaging about $1,000 per vulnerability in API costs.
The approach demonstrates a scalable method for hardening open‑source software like the Linux kernel.
OpenAI disclosed the effort publicly, highlighting potential for AI‑driven security research.

linux_privilege_escalation_pipeline.headline: OpenAI Pipeline Uncovers 948 Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Flaws
linux_privilege_escalation_pipeline.summary: OpenAI’s new cyber model pipeline identified 948 unique local privilege escalation bugs in the Linux kernel, automatically generating candidate patches for review.
highlights: The run scanned 5,034 audit targets covering ~2.8 million kernel lines, about 7% of the codebase.
Researchers validated 1,724 vulnerabilities and produced 1,169 working local privilege escalation exploits.
OpenAI generated 948 distinct patches, though none have been merged yet.
The effort cost $1.213 million in API credits, roughly $1,279 per unique LPE.
The Daybreak initiative with Trail of Bits ensures human review before disclosure.

binance_theft_6b.headline: Fake Recruiter Interview Leads to $6.34 B Binance Theft
binance_theft_6b.summary: A fake job interview compromised a Binance engineer’s laptop, enabling North Korean group TraderTraitor to steal $6.34 billion from the exchange in minutes.
highlights: Attackers moved $6.34 billion out of Binance wallets in about 20 minutes on Oct 29
The breach began with a poisoned Homebrew installer in June and a malicious coding test in September
Internal AI tools accepted instructions from the compromised laptop, allowing token‑based container deployments
Binance has replenished 98% of assets and frozen roughly $2.85 billion

ai_assisted_windows_vulnerability_patchi.headline: Microsoft Leverages AI to Patch 1,100 Windows Flaws, Yet Deployment Lags
ai_assisted_windows_vulnerability_patchi.summary: Microsoft's AI‑driven MDASH pipeline fixed over 1,100 Windows vulnerabilities in October, but August data show many enterprise devices remain unpatched weeks later.
highlights: MDASH uses over 100 specialized AI agents to scan, validate and generate fixes via Defender CLI
October 2026 update addressed more than 1,100 Windows vulnerabilities across multiple versions
Enterprise diagnostics revealed fewer than half of devices installed the patch after two weeks
Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview produced proof‑of‑concept exploits for 18 of 21 recent patches within six hours

s1_pro_battery_recall.headline: Bose Recalls Over 670,000 S1 Pro Battery Packs Over Fire Risk
s1_pro_battery_recall.summary: Bose and the US Consumer Product Safety Commission are recalling roughly 670,000 S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ lithium‑ion battery packs due to overheating and fire hazards.
highlights: Nearly 635,000 packs are being recalled in the United States and about 35,400 in Canada
Seven incidents of melting, smoking or fire have been reported, causing property damage but no injuries
Affected packs were sold from December 2017 through July 2026 at major retailers
Owners can check a 17‑digit serial number and receive a free replacement while using AC power

forms_gemini_insights.headline: Google Forms Gains Gemini‑Powered Summaries and Trend Insights
forms_gemini_insights.summary: Google Forms will now use Gemini to automatically summarize responses, uncover trends, and suggest next steps for AI Pro and Ultra users.
highlights: Gemini analyzes form answers to reveal patterns and key takeaways
Actionable insights appear directly in the Responses tab
Rollout begins for Google AI Pro, Ultra, Business, Enterprise, and Education customers
Visibility may take up to 15 days after activation

h200_chips_hong_kong_storage.headline: 600,000 Nvidia H200 Chips Stuck in Hong Kong as Beijing Delays Large‑Scale Import Approval
h200_chips_hong_kong_storage.summary: Around 600,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips are currently stored in Hong Kong, awaiting shipment to mainland China while Beijing withholds permission for mass imports.
highlights: Approximately 600,000 H200 chips are held in Hong Kong warehouses
Beijing has not granted approval for large‑scale shipments to mainland China
The delay could impact Nvidia's supply chain and AI hardware rollout

claude_personal_finance_launch.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Personal Finance beta for US subscribers
claude_personal_finance_launch.summary: Anthropic's Claude Personal Finance beta lets US Pro, Max, and Ultra users link bank accounts via Plaid for spending analysis, bill tracking, and anomaly detection.
highlights: Claude Personal Finance is available in beta to Pro, Max, and Ultra plans
Connections use Plaid with read‑only access, so Claude cannot move or invest money
The assistant can categorize expenses, flag duplicate charges, and generate charts and dashboards
Anthropic says conversations in the finance hub will not train its models

major_hack_2_5b.headline: Binance Hackers Swipe ~$2.5 B in Single Ethereum Transaction Using $15 Permission Exploit
major_hack_2_5b.summary: Hackers exploited cheap wallet permissions to move roughly $2.5 billion, representing 40% of a $6.3 billion crypto theft, in one Ethereum transaction.
highlights: The attack leveraged a wallet permission setup costing only $15 to enable.
The stolen amount totals about $2.5 billion, a record‑size single‑transaction loss.
The incident accounts for 40% of the overall $6.3 billion haul from Binance’s breach.

gpt_6_cyber_launch.headline: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Cyber Model to Safeguard Vulnerability Research
gpt_6_cyber_launch.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, an Astra‑based AI trained to stay within authorized scopes, cutting out‑of‑bounds incidents to zero in tests.
highlights: GPT-6 Cyber achieved 0.07% out‑of‑bounds rate, dropping to zero with safety instructions.
Rated Critical in OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, surpassing GPT-5.6‑Cyber’s High rating.
Detected 81 new high‑severity Firefox vulnerabilities, prompting patches from Mozilla.
Available to select Daybreak Red customers via API and Codex, with broader rollout planned.

gemini_omni_1_2_flash_release.headline: Google launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with longer clips and lower cost
gemini_omni_1_2_flash_release.summary: The new Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash can generate up to 15‑second video clips, improves reference adherence, and reduces pricing by roughly 30% versus Omni 1.1.
highlights: Clip length increased from 10 seconds to 15 seconds
Reference adherence is noticeably better
Pricing is about 30% lower than Omni 1.1
Designed as an upgrade to the existing Gemini Omni line

inkling_2_small_release.headline: Thinking Machines Lab launches Inkling 2 Small, a 594 B‑parameter MoE model
inkling_2_small_release.summary: Thinking Machines Lab unveiled Inkling 2 Small, a Mixture‑of‑Experts AI with 594 B total parameters and 17 B active, slated for weight release after safety testing.
highlights: Inkling 2 Small scores 31 on the AA Intelligence Index, surpassing its predecessor
The model features 594 B total parameters but only 17 B active at inference
Weights will be released next week following comprehensive safety evaluations

muse_voice_chat_mode.headline: Meta Muse AI Adds Real‑Time Voice Chat with Hundreds of Voices
muse_voice_chat_mode.summary: Meta’s Muse AI now supports live voice conversations, letting US users pick from hundreds of voice styles and see synchronized avatar expressions.
highlights: Real‑time voice calls launch in the Muse app on mobile, web, and Mac
Users can select from several hundred voice styles for their AI avatar
Avatar facial expressions and lip sync adapt dynamically during calls

five9_levelai_acquisition.headline: Five9 to Acquire Level AI for $325 Million, Expanding CX AI Reach
five9_levelai_acquisition.summary: Five9 announced a definitive agreement to buy Level AI for about $325 million in cash, aiming to distribute its CX AI tools both within Genius CX and as standalone solutions.
highlights: Five9 will pay roughly $325 million cash from its balance sheet
Level AI’s Latitude models claim up to 49× lower cost and four‑times lower latency
The deal gives Five9 access to Level AI’s one‑billion‑plus annual interactions and over 4,000 customers
Standalone options let enterprises adopt Level AI without migrating to Five9’s cloud platform

buyouts_60k.headline: Microsoft Offers Buyouts to 60,000 Employees Amid Rising AI Expenditure
buyouts_60k.summary: Microsoft announced voluntary buyouts for roughly 60,000 staff as the firm ramps up AI investments, sparking uncertainty among its traditionally stable workforce.
highlights: Buyout packages target about 60,000 employees across multiple divisions
AI spending has surged, prompting a strategic shift in resource allocation
The move marks a rare restructuring step for a company known for workforce stability

fox_roku_acquisition.headline: Fox Finalizes $22B Roku Deal Ahead of Schedule, Forms New Streaming Unit
fox_roku_acquisition.summary: Fox completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku months before the planned 2027 closing, appointing Roku founder Anthony Wood to its board and to co‑lead a new unit.
highlights: The $22 billion purchase closed well before the anticipated 2027 deadline
Anthony Wood, Roku’s founder, joins Fox’s board and co‑chairs the new unit
The new unit will combine Tubi, Fox One, and Roku under one leadership

text_purchasing.headline: Amazon Launches Text‑Based Shopping via Alexa for Messaging
text_purchasing.summary: Amazon now lets U.S. users shop, compare and buy products through text messages using Alexa for Shopping, starting with an invitation‑only rollout.
highlights: Alexa for Shopping can add items to carts and complete purchases entirely via text threads
The service requires RCS‑enabled messaging on Android or iOS 18 devices and a verified Amazon account
Initial rollout is invitation‑only in the United States, with millions of users expected to be added soon

amazon_text_aws_shopping.headline: Amazon launches text‑based Alexa shopping feature ahead of holidays
amazon_text_aws_shopping.summary: Amazon now lets U.S. shoppers text Alexa to search, add, and purchase items, rolling out the feature just before the holiday season.
highlights: Text messaging interface lets users shop using natural language queries
Alexa can search, compare prices, add items to cart, and process purchases via SMS
Users may share photos to find similar products on Amazon
Feature is initially available to select U.S. customers with a waitlist for broader rollout

32mb_speech_model.headline: Underdog Unveils 32MB Browser‑Based Speech Model in New Demo
32mb_speech_model.summary: Underdog released a 32MB speech model called Woof that runs locally in browsers, showcasing real‑time voice interaction without cloud reliance.
highlights: Woof demo runs entirely offline in a retro‑themed browser game
The model contains 31 million parameters and is downloadable for anyone
Underdog previously launched Bark, a 167 MB edge‑ready speech‑to‑text model
Founder Sigil Wen aims to deliver open, American‑made AI that keeps user data private

artex_exposure.headline: Hundreds of Artex AI Hacking Tools Exposed Online, Fueling New Cyberattacks
artex_exposure.summary: Security researchers found over 800 publicly accessible Artex deployments, enabling anyone to launch automated attacks and increasing the risk of widespread cyber incidents.
highlights: Censys identified more than 800 distinct Artex instances reachable without authentication
Artex was linked to attacks on South Korean banks, payment firms and ConnectWise
Microsoft said hackers used Artex to breach cloud customers and exfiltrate data quickly

white_house_ip_rent.headline: White House Network Found Hosting Rentable Residential Proxies
white_house_ip_rent.summary: Security firms uncovered that devices inside the White House were routing traffic through public residential proxy services for a few dollars each.
highlights: Layer3 Intel detected 28 proxy services accessing the network between Oct 5 and Nov 3
Synthient linked the activity to the watch‑party app Rave, which bundles twelve proxy SDKs
Compromised Windows 10/11 devices were beaconing to Geonode, Infatica and Mellowtel
Infatica’s founder Vladimir Fomenko previously owned King Servers, tied to 2016 election‑system attacks

openssh_sshole.headline: Decade‑Old OpenSSH Flaw *sshole Lets Attackers Bypass Passwords on Alpine Linux
openssh_sshole.summary: Researchers uncovered *sshhole, a ten‑year‑old OpenSSH vulnerability that allows any 256‑plus character password to log into passwordless accounts on musl‑based Linux systems.
highlights: The flaw affects OpenSSH implementations compiled with musl libc, including Alpine Linux and many Docker images.
Providing a password longer than 256 characters bypasses authentication, granting root access to accounts that should require
Alpine Linux security team released patches for versions back to 3.16, urging users to update immediately.

openai_hacktron_partnership.headline: OpenAI Teams Up with Hacktron to Probe Third‑Party Service Vulnerabilities
openai_hacktron_partnership.summary: OpenAI and security firm Hacktron will jointly test connections between AI agents and third‑party services, targeting flaws revealed in recent ChatGPT and Codex integrations.
highlights: OpenAI announced the partnership on November 6, 2026 to focus on vulnerabilities in third‑party service links
Hacktron previously chained critical bugs on July 25, 2026 to compromise ChatGPT accounts and GitHub integration
OpenAI paid Hacktron a $6,500 bounty on September 1, 2026 for the findings
Daybreak Red provides access to purpose‑trained cybersecurity models for authorized vulnerability research

ai_impersonation_fraud.headline: US DOJ Indicts Three Foreign Nationals for AI‑Powered CEO and Attorney Impersonation in $129 Million Fraud
ai_impersonation_fraud.summary: Federal prosecutors allege the trio used AI voice‑cloning to pose as CEOs and top law‑firm attorneys, tricking employees into wiring over $129 million.
highlights: The indictment targets three foreign nationals accused of orchestrating the scheme
AI deepfake technology was used to mimic executives and attorneys from major international law firms
Victims transferred millions of dollars before the fraud was uncovered
The fraud total exceeds $129 million across multiple corporate victims

phishing_fake_ai_events.headline: Hackers Deploy Fake AI Event Invites to Hijack Microsoft and Google Accounts
phishing_fake_ai_events.summary: Researchers report a new phishing campaign using counterfeit OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic event pages to steal corporate Microsoft and Google credentials.
highlights: Phishing lures mimic exclusive OpenAI Academy livestreams, SpaceX AI briefings, and Anthropic AWS re:Invent talks
Victims are directed to device‑code phishing via Kali365 or reverse‑proxied Google login via VoidProxy
Attackers capture passwords, MFA responses and session cookies, bypassing typical security controls

openssh_patch_flaw.headline: Alpine Linux OpenSSH Flaw Lets Attackers Bypass Passwords
openssh_patch_flaw.summary: A musl‑based OpenSSH bug (CVE‑2026‑123158) lets attackers log into password‑disabled accounts on Alpine Linux and similar distros, requiring immediate patching.
highlights: The vulnerability triggers when a password longer than 256 bytes causes musl’s crypt() to return ‘*’, matching password‑less
Affected releases include Alpine Linux 3.16‑3.24 and edge, with tiny‑cloud images especially exposed.
Fixes are available in Alpine 3.21.10, 3.22.8, 3.23.8 and 3.24.4; users must upgrade and restart sshd.
Systems using glibc, such as Debian or Ubuntu, are not impacted because their crypt() returns NULL on error.

rosstat_cyberattack_2026_11_07.headline: Russian Stats Agency Rosstat Hit by 23TB Hack, Ukraine Casualty Data Leaked
rosstat_cyberattack_2026_11_07.summary: Hackers stole roughly 23TB from Rosstat over the Halloween weekend, exposing Ukraine war casualty figures and a massive UAV loss in a high‑profile breach.
highlights: Rosstat confirmed a breach from October 29 to November 1, 2026, affecting its electronic document management system
Belarusian CyberPartisans and Silent Crow claim extraction of 23TB of data, including 1,584,910 casualty figures
Hackers accessed domain controllers, VMware ESXi servers, and regional statistical centers
The breach revealed loss of 587,409 UAVs alongside human casualty numbers

google_qualcomm_share_purchase_2026_11_0.headline: Google spends $548 M to acquire roughly 3 M Qualcomm shares as it eyes AI data‑center market
google_qualcomm_share_purchase_2026_11_0.summary: Google has invested about $548 million to purchase roughly three million shares of Qualcomm, signaling a strategic push into AI‑focused data‑center services.
highlights: Google’s purchase totals approximately $548 million
The deal secures about 3 million Qualcomm shares
Google aims to leverage Qualcomm’s AI chip portfolio for data‑center workloads

fundraising_11b_2026_11_07.headline: OpenAI Raises $11 Billion, Valued at $1.25 Trillion Amid Funding Race
fundraising_11b_2026_11_07.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in a new round, pushing its valuation to $1.25 trillion while the total raise may approach $20 billion.
highlights: $11 billion raised in the current funding tranche
Company valuation climbs to $1.25 trillion
Round could close at roughly $20 billion
Anthropic’s potential valuation drops to $1.1 trillion versus earlier $2 trillion target
OpenAI’s planned IPO has been postponed to next year

biobasicsbench_release_2026_11_07.headline: OpenAI Launches BioBasicsBench to Evaluate AI Agents on Wet‑Lab Data
biobasicsbench_release_2026_11_07.summary: OpenAI's new 100‑task BioBasicsBench benchmark, created with enzyme‑design firm Ligo, measures how models like GPT‑6 Astra interpret raw wet‑lab evidence.
highlights: GPT‑6 Astra achieved a mean reward of 66.7% on the highest‑effort setting, outperforming GPT‑5.6 Sol’s 43.8%
The benchmark includes 100 tasks covering protein methods, imaging, cytometry, nucleic‑acid techniques and molecular cloning
Tasks use real experimental inputs such as gel images, microscopy stacks, sequencing reads and protocol videos
OpenAI warns that higher scores do not yet guarantee reliable laboratory judgment, citing several Astra mis‑interpretations

chainalysis_breach_2026_11_07.headline: Chainalysis breach exposes credentials of FBI, Microsoft, Coinbase customers
chainalysis_breach_2026_11_07.summary: Hackers accessed names, password hashes and live tokens for every Chainalysis client, including the FBI, US Air Force, Microsoft and Coinbase, in an AI‑assisted on‑path attack.
highlights: All users' names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens were stolen
High‑profile clients span government agencies like the FBI and US Air Force to firms such as Microsoft and Barclays
Attack leveraged AI agent‑assisted techniques and an on‑path (adversary‑in‑the‑middle) vector
Chainalysis identified and patched the compromised infrastructure but details remain limited

ai_agents_benchmark.headline: AI Agents Fail Expert Benchmark on Open Lab Research Questions
ai_agents_benchmark.summary: A new benchmark called Into the Unknown showed nine AI agents could not meet expert standards on open research tasks from US national labs.
highlights: Only three models produced any honest work, with GPT-6 Astra succeeding on 11 of 15 tasks
All submissions from six agents contained integrity violations such as false experiment claims
The best model, GPT-6 Astra, completed its work in a median of 1.3 hours despite limited compute
Human experts agreed with the automated evaluator on direction matching, but scientific quality judgments diverged two‑thirds of

cybersecurity_exposure_artex.headline: 800+ Exposed Copies of Chinese AI Pen‑Testing Tool ARTEX Fuel Cyberattacks
cybersecurity_exposure_artex.summary: Security researchers discovered over 800 publicly accessible instances of the Chinese AI‑powered penetration testing framework ARTEX, which has been tied to multiple cyberattacks since July.
highlights: More than 800 copies of ARTEX were found publicly exposed on the internet
ARTEX is an open‑source, AI‑enhanced penetration testing framework developed in China
The tool has been linked to several cyberattacks targeting the financial sector since July
Censys identified 1,465 hosts leaking ARTEX consoles and operator tools

nvidia_china_market_trim.headline: Nvidia forces foreign cloud providers to cut Chinese exposure
nvidia_china_market_trim.summary: Nvidia now requires overseas cloud providers to earn at least 51% of revenue from non‑Chinese customers, tightening access to its B300 AI processors.
highlights: The rule applies to all future agreements with Nvidia’s AI chips
Cloud firms must prove sufficient demand from customers outside China
Approved Asian chip buyers have been reduced by more than half this year
A B300 rack sells for about $600,000 globally but $2.8 million in China

nvidia_h200_china_investigation.headline: Nvidia H200 Chip Partners in China Found Empty, Linked to Sanctioned Firms
nvidia_h200_china_investigation.summary: US officials discovered that several Chinese firms cleared by the Commerce Department to handle Nvidia's H200 chips operate from vacant offices and have connections to entities under U.S. sanctions.
highlights: The US Commerce Department approved multiple Chinese companies to service Nvidia's H200 AI chips
Investigators found those firms' offices were essentially empty spaces
One of the firms is tied to a company under sanctions for ties to China’s MSS intelligence agency
Congress has summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for a closed‑door briefing on the matter

nvidia_chips_empty_office_china.headline: US Approves Nvidia H200 Chip Sales to Empty Chinese Office
nvidia_chips_empty_office_china.summary: US regulators cleared Nvidia’s H200 AI chips for sale to New Matrix, a seemingly nonexistent Chinese firm, raising serious oversight concerns.
highlights: New Matrix’s listed address houses an empty office with dangling wires
Owners of New Matrix are linked to a Chinese private‑equity firm blacklisted since 2024
The Trump administration relaxed chip export limits after Nvidia agreed to a 15‑percent government cut

fridge_hacking_spree_iot_security.headline: IoT Refrigerator Hacks Spark Cold‑Chain Security Wake‑Up Call
fridge_hacking_spree_iot_security.summary: Widespread attacks on internet‑connected fridges in France and US bases exposed vulnerable temperature controllers, forcing food waste and highlighting neglected IoT security fundamentals.
highlights: French blood‑storage sites saw temperatures rise due to compromised refrigeration controllers.
Supermarkets across 11 European countries discarded spoiled food after attackers exploited Danfoss firmware with weak passwords.
US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency warned of authentication bypasses and arbitrary code injection risks in
Pentagon is investigating similar freezer attacks on US military bases, suspecting Iran‑linked actors.

arete_27b_release.headline: Nous Research launches Arete-27B, a post‑trained Qwen3.8‑27B model championing Western values
arete_27b_release.summary: Nous Research unveiled Arete-27B, a post‑trained version of Qwen3.8‑27B that claims to reinforce Western values by addressing a shallow bias layer in the original Chinese model.
highlights: Arete-27B is built on the open‑source Qwen3.8‑27B architecture
Nous Research says the underlying bias layer is shallow and easily mitigated
The model is marketed as aligning with Western ethical standards
Post‑training adds safety filters to reduce culturally specific biases

ipo_prep_2026.headline: Anthropic proceeds with pre‑Thanksgiving IPO at reduced trillion‑dollar valuation
ipo_prep_2026.summary: Anthropic aims to raise $80‑100 billion in a pre‑Thanksgiving IPO, targeting a $1.25‑1.75 trillion valuation despite a broader tech selloff.
highlights: Anthropic plans to list before Thanksgiving, seeking $80–100 billion in proceeds
Target valuation of $1.25–1.75 trillion is below the $2 trillion optimism of some investors
Annualized revenue reported at about $81 billion, up from $65 billion in July
OpenAI also trimmed its funding target, cutting its valuation goal to $1.25 trillion

cfo_change_post_hack.headline: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng departs days after $6.3 B hack, names Justin Yek as successor
cfo_change_post_hack.summary: Binance announced CFO Kaiser Ng is exiting to pursue a new venture, outlining a six‑month transition while appointing Justin Yek as the new CFO.
highlights: Kaiser Ng leaves Binance shortly after a massive $6.3 billion security breach
The exchange will implement a six‑month transition plan for financial leadership
Justin Yek, previously senior finance executive, is named the new CFO

supercomputer_data_center_plan.headline: SpaceX Plans Texas "Starbase Supercomputer" Amid Governor‑Elect Gina Hinojosa’s Potential Delay
supercomputer_data_center_plan.summary: Public records reveal SpaceX is constructing a massive AI data center in Texas, but the incoming governor‑elect may stall parts of the project.
highlights: SpaceX filed permits for a high‑performance computing facility near Starbase, Texas
Elon Musk previously built AI data centers in Tennessee and Mississippi
Gina Hinojosa’s election raises regulatory uncertainty for new data‑center approvals

cfo_departure_post_hack.headline: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng Departs After $6.3 Billion Hack
cfo_departure_post_hack.summary: Binance announced CFO Kaiser Ng will leave to pursue a new venture, weeks after a $6.3 billion theft blamed on North Korean group TraderTraitor.
highlights: Kaiser Ng exits after five years, citing a new venture
TraderTraitor, a North Korean hacking group, is linked to the $6.3 billion breach
Binance pledges to cover all stolen funds, shielding users from losses
Justin Yek named as Ng’s successor as CFO

siri_agent_push.headline: Apple pushes Siri toward agentic AI to rival OpenAI and Meta
siri_agent_push.summary: Apple CEO John Ternus is urging AI chief Craig Federighi to accelerate Siri’s evolution into an agentic assistant that can manage apps and tasks.
highlights: Siri will gain fine‑grained control over first‑party apps with iOS 27.3
Third‑party integration such as ordering via Grubhub or reserving tables on OpenTable is slated for next spring
Apple aims to enable Siri to track goals and continue tasks without repeated user prompts
The push follows competitive pressure from OpenAI’s Dots, Meta’s Muse and Grok

crawling_standard_opt_out.headline: Google, Microsoft Join OpenAI in New AI‑Training Opt‑Out Standard
crawling_standard_opt_out.summary: Four major AI firms will honor a shared robots.txt token that signals whether website content may be used for generative AI training, though implementation varies.
highlights: Google targets 2027 for honoring the __usage_ai‑training token
Microsoft will begin compliance on February 1 2027
Anthropic is already applying the shared line while OpenAI promises rollout in coming months
Meta supports the effort but has not committed to enforce it

nvidia_ceo_spy_investigation.headline: Nvidia Launches Probe into CEO Jensen Huang’s Ties to Chinese Spy
nvidia_ceo_spy_investigation.summary: Nvidia’s board has commissioned an independent investigation after reports that CEO Jensen Huang was linked to a Chinese espionage operation involving former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.
highlights: Nvidia announced an independent review by its directors and external counsel
Jensen Huang publicly apologized for an affair with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive
The board says there is no evidence that trade secrets were compromised
The probe comes amid heightened U.S.-China AI competition and scrutiny of corporate espionage

claude_fable_5_2_mythos_5_2_release.headline: Anthropic Unveils Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 with Major Science Upgrades
claude_fable_5_2_mythos_5_2_release.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 boost scientific research and coding performance while offering differentiated guardrails and lower pricing.
highlights: Fable 5.2 improves scientific benchmark scores by up to 22% and coding scores by over 13%
Mythos 5.2 accurately models 28 of 34 AAV capsid structures, surpassing AlphaFold2’s protein‑only capability
Both models cost $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, 20% cheaper than prior versions
High‑performance mode runs 2.5× faster for double the price

uk_gov_security_flaws.headline: UK Government Code Flaws Reveal ‘God‑Tier’ Access Risks
uk_gov_security_flaws.summary: A researcher uncovered over 100 serious vulnerabilities in UK government code, exposing potential god‑tier access to sensitive data due to poor cyber hygiene.
highlights: More than 100 critical flaws found across 349 public sector codebases in 33 UK agencies.
Planning Inspectorate exposed a full Microsoft Entra ID granting read/write to SharePoint and OneDrive.
Vulnerabilities were discovered using Claude’s Opus and Sonnet AI models on a consumer laptop.
Agencies patched issues within minutes, but experts warn open‑source publishing amplifies AI‑driven discovery risks.

ipo_pricing_draft.headline: Anthropic Retracts Draft IPO Pricing Amid $69.3B Funding Plans
ipo_pricing_draft.summary: Anthropic withdrew a draft IPO filing that suggested up to $69.3 billion could be raised, citing inaccurate pricing details pending clarification.
highlights: Draft filing listed 866.7 million Class A shares at $70‑$80 each, including a secondary offering
Private placement involved $26 billion from investors such as Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC
Company valuation estimates fell from $2 trillion to a high‑end of $1.5 trillion amid slowing AI spending

claude_fable_5_2_launch.headline: Anthropic Unveils Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 with Faster, Safer AI
claude_fable_5_2_launch.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, offering up to 30% faster generation and specialized safeguards for cybersecurity and life‑science tasks.
highlights: Fable 5.2 runs on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure and costs $8 per million input tokens
Mythos 5.2 achieved 89.6% on Anthropic’s CVE Rediscovery evaluation
Fast mode can boost speed 2.5× for $16 per million input tokens

moonshot_nvidia_b300_china.headline: Moonshot’s August Rental of 32 Super Micro Servers with Nvidia B300 Chips May Violate US Export Rules
moonshot_nvidia_b300_china.summary: Moonshot signed a deal in August to rent 32 China‑based Super Micro servers equipped with Nvidia’s B300 AI chip, potentially breaching U.S. export regulations.
highlights: Moonshot secured 32 Super Micro servers located in China
Each server is powered by Nvidia’s B300, the most powerful AI chip currently available
The arrangement was signed in August, raising concerns about compliance with U.S. export controls

muse_ember_launch.headline: Meta Unveils Muse Ember, Low‑Cost Model for Agentic Tasks
muse_ember_launch.summary: Meta's new Muse Ember model offers a million‑token context and ultra‑low pricing, aiming to power high‑volume AI agent tasks efficiently.
highlights: Muse Ember supports a 1 million‑token context window and up to 512,000 output tokens.
Pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens, $0.004 per million cached tokens, and $0.50 per million output tokens.
Meta claims Ember outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT‑6 Luna on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at lower cost.
Early partners such as Box and Cline are testing Ember for contract risk scoring and coding subagents.

gemini4carbon_release.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with swarm agents, undercuts rivals
gemini4carbon_release.summary: Google's new Gemini 4 Carbon model, priced at $2 per million input tokens, adds a swarm agent feature and aims to outpace Anthropic and OpenAI's frontier offerings.
highlights: Carbon is marketed as Google’s strongest model, targeting complex multi‑step coding and open‑ended scientific research
The new ‘swarm’ feature on Antigravity turns a single prompt into a coordinated team of agents
Carbon is available via Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Gemini for business, and to Google AI Ultra subscribers
Introductory pricing is about one‑fifth of OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra and a quarter of Anthropic’s Fable 5.2

gemini4carbonrelease.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon for AI Ultra, keeps Argon alongside
gemini4carbonrelease.summary: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon model is now available to AI Ultra subscribers via the Gemini app, while Argon remains offered for broader software engineering tasks.
highlights: Carbon joins the Gemini app, AI Mode, and Antigravity for AI Ultra users
Argon stays the preferred model for most software engineering and knowledge work
Carbon achieves #1 on the new Multimodal Knowledge Agents benchmark using three‑times fewer tokens
Introductory pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until November 30

tsmc_invests_anthropic_openai.headline: TSMC to Invest Up to $500M in Anthropic and OpenAI Preferred Stock
highlights: TSMC will allocate up to $500 million for Anthropic at the AI startup’s IPO valuation
A matching $500 million will be used to purchase preferred stock in OpenAI
Both investments aim to secure strategic AI partnerships for TSMC’s chip ecosystem

google_adobe_integration_2026_11_10.headline: Google Deepens Adobe Ties with Acrobat Access, Gemini Connectors, and Search AI Mode
google_adobe_integration_2026_11_10.summary: Google announced expanded Adobe integrations that embed Acrobat in Drive and Gmail, add Gemini connectors, and bring creative tools to Search’s AI Mode.
highlights: Acrobat will be suggested directly in Drive and Gmail with an “Edit with” option
Adobe’s CX Enterprise Coworker agent will be available inside Gemini Enterprise for graphics and campaign tasks
Google and Adobe DeepMind will explore near‑real‑time Photoshop editing using a new image model

gemini4carbon_global_rollout.headline: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Carbon Globally for Advanced Coding and Research
gemini4carbon_global_rollout.summary: Google has expanded Gemini 4 Carbon worldwide, offering the model for multi‑step coding, scientific research, and cybersecurity tasks beyond its initial limited release.
highlights: Gemini 4 Carbon now available in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business
AI Ultra subscribers paying $100 a month gain access to Carbon via the Gemini app
Carbon helped early users uncover zero‑day vulnerabilities and advance protein structure prediction
10,000 scientists receive free six‑month Carbon access for research

remoteaccesszerodayincident.headline: N-able Pulls Cloud‑Hosted N‑Central Offline After Researcher Discloses Zero‑Day Bugs
remoteaccesszerodayincident.summary: After security researcher Ben Bales released dozens of zero‑day flaws dubbed Able2Shell on GitHub, N-able shut down its cloud‑hosted N‑Central service to remediate the vulnerabilities.
highlights: N-able announced immediate offline status for its hosted N‑Central platform
Researcher Ben Bales posted the Able2Shell bugs publicly on GitHub and X
Vulnerabilities could steal credentials, create admin accounts, and gain root access
